title: Fleet-Wide Tangle
description: A chaotic scheduling day: multiple shipments, drivers, and vehicles with a mix of clean assignments and deliberate overlaps on both dimensions. The conflicts endpoint needs to surface every real conflict and nothing that isn't one, across a busier board than a single pair.
successCondition: Book five shipments. Create assignments so that: shipments 1 and 2 share a vehicle with overlapping windows (a vehicle conflict), shipments 3 and 4 share a driver with overlapping windows (a driver conflict), and shipment 5 has a unique vehicle/driver/window that overlaps nothing. GET /api/fleet/conflicts returns exactly one "vehicle" conflict (assignmentIds covering shipments 1 and 2's assignments) and exactly one "driver" conflict (covering 3 and 4's), with no conflict entry referencing shipment 5's assignment at all.
hints: Keep a clear mapping from shipment number to assignment id as you build this out — with five assignments in flight it's easy to lose track of which id belongs to which shipment.

Give shipments 1/2 and 3/4 completely disjoint vehicle/driver pairs from each other so the two conflicts don't accidentally interact (e.g. don't reuse a vehicleId from the first pair as a driverId anywhere else — those are different id spaces anyway, but keep every non-shared field genuinely distinct).
